data.name: Mughira
data.gender_notes: Mughira is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mughira is a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and a prominent figure in Islamic history. The name Mughira carries the meaning “Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mughira usually hope their child will grow to embody companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of loyalty, dedication, and friendship in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Mughira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mughira total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.meaning: مغیرہ کا مطلب ہے مختلف اور متغیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: مغیرہ ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو مختلف اور متغیر ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں معروف ہے اور اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے۔ مغیرہ نام رکھنے والا شخص عام طور پر ایک متغیر اور متحرک شخصیت کا حامل ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुगीरह
in_hindi.meaning: मुगीरह का अर्थ है विभिन्न और परिवर्तनशील
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुगीरह एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है विभिन्न और परिवर्तनशील। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में प्रसिद्ध है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी आया है। मुगीरह नाम रखने वाला व्यक्ति आमतौर पर एक परिवर्तनशील और गतिशील व्यक्तित्व का धारक होता है।

in_pashto.name: مغیرہ
in_pashto.meaning: مغیرہ د مختلف او متغیر مطلب
in_pashto.long_meaning: مغیرہ یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی د مختلف او متغیر سړی معنی دی. دا نوم د اسلامي کیلنڈر په مشهور دی او د قران کریم کې یې هم ذکر شوی دی. مغیرہ نوم لرونکی سړی معمولاً د یو متغیر او فعال شخصیت خاوند دی.

in_english.name: Mughira
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root meaning 'different' or 'changeable'
in_english.long_meaning: Mughira is a masculine given name originating from Arabic, meaning 'different' or 'changeable'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'غ-ي-ر' (gh-y-r), which connotes change, variation, and difference. The name Mughira appears in various Islamic texts, including the Quran, and is associated with individuals known for their dynamic and adaptable nature. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person with a transformative and progressive personality.

data.cultural_impact: Mughira is a name of Arabic origin, with its roots in pre-Islamic Arab society. The name Mughira has been used throughout Islamic history, particularly in the context of early Muslim poetry and literature. It is associated with the concept of courage and bravery, as Mughira was a renowned fighter in the Battle of Badr, one of the earliest and most significant battles fought between the Muslims and their Meccan opponents. This cultural legacy continues to influence contemporary Arab culture, where the name Mughira is often given to boys as a nod to the rich history and valor of Arab traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Mughira is revered as a Sahabi (companion) of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), and his name is consigned to the annals of Islamic history as a symbol of faith, bravery, and devotion. As a Sahabi, Mughira had the unique opportunity to learn directly from the Prophet (PBUH), imbibing the message of Islam and living a life in accordance with its teachings. His story serves as a reminder to Muslims of the importance of courage, unwavering faith, and a commitment to the truth. Moreover, the example of Mughira and his companions demonstrates the power of unity among Muslims and their ability to overcoming adversity and persevering against all odds. Thus, the name Mughira carries deep spiritual significance, representing a connection to the Prophet (PBUH) and embodying the ideals of faith, courage, and perseverance that continue to inspire Muslims today.
